purpose: Mini-adversary pass on the teams integration: dispatch as JSON per room, rosters, crew rooms and dossiers

seats.name: fit-critic
seats.reason: fit with the cockpit's purpose and the commander's teams direction
seats.returns: findings, three to fix first, verdict

seats.name: trim-critic
seats.reason: bulk and duplication between dispatch entries, rosters, dossiers and the manifest
seats.returns: findings with what is lost per cut, top three

outcome: fit-critic 14 findings, trim-critic 10, agreeing on one defect: a seat's identity written by hand into four files and already drifted three times. Applied: crew.json owns identity; dispatch seats are name, reason, returns; rosters are name lists; dossiers cut to purpose, how to dispatch, record, next time; five retired dossiers deleted with their status carried in the manifest; two turn-opener citations in the spec-builder dossier fixed; rules 7 and 10 name every store; status enums honoured; room indexes added. JSON 857 to 501 lines.
lessons: one owner per fact: the manifest owns who a seat is, the team entry owns what a team did, the dossier owns how to brief it, the README explains
a dossier briefs a seat; history goes in the team entry
a change in one room is a change in every room that points into it, again
run the mini-adversary roster on any structural rebuild before logging off
